channel.title: Sky Chapter
channel.description: The sky, one chapter a day.

item.title: Sky Chapter · Chapter 1 / Day 1 — “The Moon Meets Saturn”
item.description: The Moon climbs through Aries and bumps into retrograde Saturn — gas pedal meets brake. Above them, Mars and Jupiter hold hands in Leo.

item.title: Sky Chapter · Chapter 2 / Day 2 — “Full Moon on the Wire”
item.description: The Moon is almost full and walks a tightrope: it stands exactly across from Venus. Heart says yes, balance says wait.

item.title: Sky Chapter · Chapter 3 / Day 3 — “The Season Flips”
item.description: The Sun just stepped into Sagittarius — the season flips from depth to distance. Underfoot, an almost-full Moon rests in steady Taurus.

item.title: Sky Chapter · Chapter 4 / Day 4 — “Fire Meets Fire”
item.description: Fire meets fire: the brand-new Sagittarius Sun squares Mars and Jupiter still fused in Leo, while the Moon swells to 99% in Taurus. The season's first real test arrives before anyone has finished unpacking.

item.title: Sky Chapter · Chapter 5 / Day 5 — “The Moon Changes Rooms”
item.description: The full Moon packs up and moves house — out of Taurus, into Gemini, still 99.8% lit and standing across from the Sagittarius Sun. Down in Leo, Mars sits 0.4° from Virgo with Jupiter still glued to him; the day's tightest line is the Moon's near-exact sextile to retrograde Saturn — the chatter meets a brake.

item.title: Sky Chapter · Chapter 6 / Day 6 — “Mars Crosses the Line”
item.description: Mars crossed the line. At 0° Virgo he has stepped out of the fire and into the workshop, while Jupiter sits almost pinned in Leo at 26°34′, moving just 0.05° a day. The conjunction is still live at 3.45°, but the two are in different rooms now. The Moon sails on to 23° Gemini — waning gibbous, 97.1% — trining Venus and sextiling Jupiter: the soft way through stays wide open.
